user_saw: When a Dashboard update failed, the operator saw an INFO completion entry in the Gateway log that omitted the reason.
summary: The Gateway now logs failed Dashboard updates at WARN with a public reason and a sanitized error summary.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already logged the same status-only INFO completion entry for results that could carry an error reason. PR #128868 introduced the upstream-mismatch refusal used in the fix's reproduction and left the completion logger alone. The available path history stops at the shallow boundary, so I could not establish when the general logging defect began or whether an earlier version logged those reasons.
